a_capture_record_must: name the producer module it launched, resolve this chain's head, and carry the resolved kind beside the verbatim ExecMainStatus; a producer absent from the head is recorded UNMAPPED by name
chain_head_rule: vN+1 by the {path, sha256} pair; readers resolve the chain head by the <family>_v<N>.json glob and follow the pair; ONE producer's block is added or changed per version, by that producer, with the pair from the head it read; v1 is never edited

live/pm_research/da_gate1_day_verdict.py.known_from_prose_only: exit 3 = PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE per Q-DA-325 -- prose, not a map; UNMAPPED until DA's block lands

live/pm_research/de_multiday_gate1_runne.75_is_never_this_producer_s: 75 is the launch layer's: `flock -n -E 75` means a HELD LOCK and the payload never started. If this producer ever exited 75 a refusal and a held lock would be indistinguishable in `ExecMainStatus`, which is the whole point of `-E` (R-646 R2)
live/pm_research/de_multiday_gate1_runne.declared_by: DE, at DE 108, by the pair

map.0: the run completed and the artifact was written
map.1: RunnerRefused, or a battery failure -- SystemExit with a message. Every refusal this producer raises exits 1

live/pm_research/de_multiday_gate1_runne.the_map_is_the_module_s_own: read from `RUNNER_EXIT_CODES` in the runner, which `assert_no_exit_code_collision()` already checks against the declared lock-conflict code at every emit
live/pm_research/de_multiday_gate1_runne.what_is_NOT_in_this_map: the launch layer's codes (75 held lock, 76 the launcher's own protocol error). They belong to the wrapper, not to the producer, and a producer's map that claimed them would be claiming another layer's vocabulary

reading_kinds.declared code: a VERDICT by name, resolved in the producer's block
reading_kinds.undeclared non-zero: UNMAPPED -- a number observed and nothing learned; NOT a refusal, NOT a failure, and it does NOT satisfy a GO conditioned on that run (the predicate is not evaluable; the GO waits, the producer declares the code by pair, the record is re-read)

runtime_default.1: the interpreter's uncaught exception -- a CRASH, not a verdict, unless the producer's own block declares 1 otherwise

sibling_of.why_a_sibling: the form's constants are the WRAPPER's (lock path, conflict code, caps) and belong to every producer alike; an exit map is one producer's own and would make the shared form change whenever any producer added a code (REV 79 §2.1)

what: One block per producer that runs under the heavy-run lock: {exit code: meaning}. A capture record resolves a non-zero ExecMainStatus HERE, never in the producer's source. A code with no entry is recorded VERBATIM as UNMAPPED and is not a reading.
what_this_is_not: not a list of the wrapper's five fields (heavy_run_form), not a permission (a declared code is a reading, decisions live in the policy layer, rule 14)

75.meaning: EX_TEMPFAIL -- the heavy-run lock is held; the unit did NO work and wrote nothing (rule 20)
75.owner: the launch form (flock -n -E 75 inside the unit)
75.where_enforced: a producer whose declared block contains 75 is refused at its own selftest (REV 68 §3.2)
